Matt Chen: Quick context — DeepSail signed for Dedicated (6-GPU pool) last week. Sales notes: mid-market ML infra company, POC completed. Open items before GA: SSO via Okta, VPC peering for private endpoints, and a migration plan for embeddings (they currently host a retriever on-prem). Renewal clocks start in ~11 months but finance flagged cost sensitivity — likely to ask for unit-cost optimization later. P0 blockers: missing SAML cert + their firewall blocks outbound to our health-check IPs. Owners: Matt (sales) owner for contract/questions, Ari (CS) owner for onboarding/runbook, Jin (support) owner for infra/certs, Olivia (CSE) owner for enablement/workshops. Can we sync on owners + next steps?

Ari Patel: Thanks Matt. I'll take the onboarding checklist. Two quick Qs: do we have their SAML metadata and the proposed peering CIDR? Also can someone add a short summary for the runbook (auth, network, model config) so I can hand to support?

Olivia Ramos: I can run the enablement session and record it. Prefer Tue 10am PT next week for a 90m deep-dive (deploy + prompt best practices + embeddings migration). Need: 1) service account invite to their dev workspace, 2) a list of example docs + sample corpus size for embedding tuning. :+1:

Jin Park: I'll own the VPC peering and cert install. Requirements from my side: VPC CIDR ranges, the firewall egress rules (ports 443 and 5222 allowed?), and a run of the health-check curl once peering is up. If they have any failed SAML handshakes, drop the SP metadata or the IdP logs. Sample test we ask them to run:
```bash
curl -v -H "Host: private-api.deepredwood.example" https://10.52.10.17/healthz
```
Also need to know which model family they'll pin (gpt-large or custom quantized) so I can size caches.

Matt Chen: Adding details — SAML metadata link: https://deepsail.example/saml/metadata.xml (they gave cert via sales). Proposed peering CIDR: 10.240.0.0/16. They confirmed outbound to 10.52.10.17 is allowed once we set peering. Model family: planning to use a 13B quantized variant for cost reasons. Finance contact: Claire Huang (cced). Renewal note: indicate they may push to a committed throughput discount if costs spike.

Samir Rao: Heads-up on renewal risk — DeepSail uses heavy embedding compute early in evaluation. Recommend we include Redwood Optimize consult during onboarding to hit their cost targets and show savings w/ batching + cache. Also flag: product usage baseline report at 30/60/90 days for renewal conversation.

deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-4123 (Onboarding: DeepSail — SSO + VPC + Enablement). Assigning to @Ari, @Jin, @Olivia. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4123

Olivia Ramos: I'll prepare the slide deck + a hands-on notebook for embedding migration. Please grant me the service account role (cs-trainer) in their org and add the onboarding repo access. I'll upload recording + notes to the shared folder afterwards.

Ari Patel: Action items: 1) Matt — confirm Claire + legal redlines (by EOD Fri) 2) Jin — start peering ticket and post test steps (by Mon) 3) Olivia — create invite + schedule Tue 10am PT session (by Mon) 4) Samir — outline Optimize consult offer and 30/60/90 reporting template (by next Wed). We'll reconvene in this thread after tickets land. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
